prop_types.int: A whole number between min and max.
prop_types.code: A program identifier (letters, digits, _ . : -; at most 64 characters), never text a person typed.

events.name: page_view
events.description: A page in the app was opened. The address is de-identified in the browser.

events.name: settings_opened
events.description: Settings was opened.

events.name: onboarding_started
events.description: The Getting Started checklist was shown for the first time.

events.name: onboarding_step_completed
events.description: A Getting Started step was completed.

events.name: onboarding_completed
events.description: Every Getting Started step was completed.

events.name: onboarding_dismissed
events.description: The Getting Started checklist was dismissed.

events.name: offline_sync_drained
events.description: Changes saved on the device finished syncing.

events.name: offline_op_rejected
events.description: The server refused a change saved on the device.

events.name: offline_boot
events.description: The app started without a connection, and how long until it reconnected.

events.name: offline_detected
events.description: The app lost its connection to the server, and why it decided so.

events.name: offline_ops_expired
events.description: Changes that could not sync were discarded after 7 days.

events.name: offline_drain_error
events.description: Syncing hit a storage error and will retry.

events.name: offline_hydrate_error
events.description: Loading changes saved on the device failed and will retry.

events.name: offline_watchdog_flush
events.description: A stuck sync was restarted.

events.name: offline_store_volatile
events.description: The device's storage was unavailable, so changes are kept in memory.

events.name: offline_store_reopened
events.description: The device's storage came back and held changes were moved into it.

events.name: offline_submit_failed
events.description: A change could not be saved on the device.

events.name: offline_lock_reclaimed
events.description: One browser tab took over syncing from another that stopped answering.

events.name: offline_queue_stalled
events.description: A change has waited minutes to sync while online, and why.

events.name: offline_auth_paused
events.description: Syncing paused until the person signs in again.

events.name: landing_view
events.description: The landing page was opened.

events.name: demo_started
events.description: The live demo was opened, on which example (by its position) and whether through the tour.

events.name: demo_tour_completed
events.description: The demo tour reached its last step.

events.name: demo_write_blocked
events.description: A visitor tried to save a change in the read-only demo.

events.name: waitlist_opened
events.description: The waitlist form was opened, and from where.

events.name: waitlist_submitted
events.description: The waitlist form was sent, from where, and whether it was a new request.

events.name: invite_link_opened
events.description: A visitor went on to sign up with an invite key.
